The thick dust fog around Mars is thinning. From orbit, the surface is visible for the first time in weeks.

Pressure has passed 300 mbar. Frost now coats the highlands, and Mars glitters white at dawn.
Build the Launch Pad and fly Launch 1 to the abandoned Temperature Station to bring back the Heater.
Crater floors are filling with ice. The planet is holding onto the heat.
Keep the Heater fuelled with Greenhouse Charges. It caps at 20% of Stage 5 until you upgrade it to T2.
The polar caps are shrinking. Meltwater trickles beneath the ice sheets.
Upgrade the Heater to T3 and push the planet above -10 °C for liquid water.
Water Pump + BioSpray Tower blueprints · Aluminum Ore
The first lake has formed in Hellas Basin. Water stays liquid on the surface of Mars.
Build a Water Pump on the lake, then the BioSpray Tower to start building soil.
Red dust is turning to dark brown soil around the base. Microbes are taking hold.
Upgrade the BioSpray Tower to T3 and add pumps. Algae will start to spread.
Green algae mats now line every shore. The air carries a faint trace of oxygen.
Fly Launch 2 to Blossom Station. The Seed of Life is the key.
Forests sway under a blue sky. Clouds roll in, and for the first time in a billion years it rains on Mars.
Build the Genome Decoder and the Embryo Incubator, then bring animals to Mars: insects first, then birds, then large animals.
Bees work the sunflowers, crows argue in the pines and foxes hunt rabbits through the long grass. Mars is alive.

The colony's main building, where everything is crafted. Upgrade it to unlock bigger Qty sizes.
Opens the Mine. Extract ore from the regolith by hand, then by drone. Every extraction draws battery power.
A machine that keeps crafting for you. Pick a recipe for each slot and it crafts it on its own, using the same ingredients and energy as crafting by hand, until that item reaches its stock limit.
Pressure phase machine. Burns Thorium Rods to vent CO₂ from the crust and thicken the air.
Reusable pad for both space launches. Opens the Launch Pad tab.
Temperature phase machine (Stages 4–6). Burns Greenhouse Charges to warm the planet. Heat Cores boost its output.
Hand-cranked pump on the Hellas lake. Opens the Hydro tab. Upgrade the gearing to unlock motor pumps.
Soil phase machine (Stages 7–8). Needs no power, only water: 8 L/s at full speed (2 pumps).
Incubator where you splice seed genomes and grow them in trays. Opens the Biolab tab.
Oxygen phase machine (Stage 9). Spreads flower seeds, then tree seeds, with water. Plants breathe out O₂.
Decodes animal genomes for the Embryo Incubator. Runs on Uranium Cells. Adds the decoder to the Biolab: copy the DNA letters before time runs out.
Life phase machine (Stage 10). Grows decoded genomes into animals and releases them into the wild.
